description: Save your workspace's instrumentation setup for usage signals or costs: framework (http, vercel-ai-sdk, langchain, llamaindex, openai-agents, anthropic), language (curl, node, python, go, ruby) and templates, each optional; what you leave out stays as saved. reset: true alone puts back the defaults and keeps what was provisioned. The one click setup that creates the agent, customer and API key is not offered here: it mints a key, so it takes a person signed in to the dashboard (/event-tracking or /cost-tracing). Answers 404 until the in-app setup is switched on for your workspace. Needs a key or token not limited to scopes, or a workspace owner or admin. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

kind.description: events for usage signals (/event-tracking), costs for cost tracing (/cost-tracing).

reset.description: true alone puts back every default.

templates.description: Saved whole: the agent (and optional customer) the setup creates, and signals (kind events) or cost_types (kind costs), at most 20. Read get_instrumentation_setup first and send every template you want to keep.

unit.description: What it is counted in, such as tokens.

currency.description: Currency of the unit prices and costs. Defaults to USD.

charge_by.description: What it charges by. Defaults to event.

event_name.description: Sent as eventType: letters, digits, dots, colons, dashes, underscores.

name: save_instrumentation_setup
